name: RadioGroup
description: A set of checkable buttons where only one can be checked at a time. Built on Radix UI RadioGroup primitive with a circular indicator icon from Lucide.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the selected radio item.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled default value of the selected radio item.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback invoked when the selected value changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, prevents the user from interacting with any radio items.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the radio group, submitted with its owning form as part of a name/value pair.

props.name: required
props.description: When true, indicates that the user must select a value before the owning form can be submitted.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the radio group.

props.name: dir
props.description: The reading direction of the radio group.

props.name: loop
props.description: When true, keyboard navigation will loop from last item to first, and vice versa.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes. Merged with default 'grid gap-2' layout classes.

subComponents.name: RadioGroupItem
subComponents.description: An individual radio button item rendered as a round bordered indicator with a filled circle when selected.

props.name: value
props.description: The unique value of this radio item.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, prevents the user from interacting with this radio item.

props.name: required
props.description: When true, indicates that the user must select this item before the owning form can be submitted.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes. Merged with default styling (aspect-square, h-4, w-4, rounded-full, border, focus-visible ring).

accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys navigate between items. Space selects the focused item. Tab moves focus into/out of the group.
accessibility.aria: Automatically managed by Radix UI: aria-checked on each item, role=radiogroup on the container.
accessibility.notes: Pair each RadioGroupItem with a <Label> element using htmlFor for screen reader accessibility. Disabled items receive opacity-50 and cursor-not-allowed styling.
